orientation_note: North at top (the open field). The hedge runs east-west across the lower part; farmland beyond it at the bottom edge.

walkable.burrow: The mouth is 0.35 m across. Alice (135 cm) can only crouch or kneel and peer in, never enter (SUP-001).

The gate leaf spans the drawn 5.3 m gap (a period five-bar gate is about 3 m), 1.2 m high.
Oak: trunk 1.0 m x 7 m, crown 7-16 m.
Ditch depth 0.3 m (not modelled; marker only); spoil fan 2.2 x 1.6 m.

If the burrow is moved to the hedge foot, only burrow_mouth/spoil_fan move; the hedge geometry stays.
The Bible dates the gate at 12 m from the burrow; the drawn gate centre is 8 m away (x 0.35 vs 0.5). The model follows the drawing.
